verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a desktop or self-hosted AI app, so the axis applies. The pack has general privacy claims (local processing, 'no data leaving your device') but no documented telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out setting. Those privacy claims are adjacent, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
